---
title: "Keep the AWS SDK out of Workers that don't copy files"
description: "Drop when the pinned release keeps @aws-sdk/client-s3 out of the module graph of @payloadcms/storage-r2's main entry."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.2. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

A Worker that stores uploads with r2Storage({ bucket: env.R2 }) bundles about
890 KiB of @aws-sdk/client-s3 and @smithy code in each of its SSR and RSC
environments, 390 KiB of the compressed upload. Only file renames and upload
version restores use it: they copy objects through R2's S3 API with
copyCredentials, because the binding can't copy. The adapter loads the SDK
with a dynamic import, but Vite still bundles every dynamic import it can
reach, so every R2 site pays for the SDK. The size counts toward the Workers
upload limit, which is 3 MB compressed on the free plan.

The copyCredentials option is now copyFile, a function. createS3CopyFile from
the new @payloadcms/storage-r2/copy-file entry builds one from the same
credentials, so only a site that imports it bundles the SDK. Without the
option, a copy fails with the same kind of error as before.

- **Patch:** `r2-copy-without-aws-sdk`, committed as `fix(storage-r2): keep the AWS SDK out of Workers that don't copy files`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run --project unit packages/storage-r2/src/entryImports.spec.ts; the e2e Worker size budget (pnpm size in e2e)`
- **Diff:** [`upstream/patches/0010-fix-storage-r2-keep-the-AWS-SDK-out-of-Workers-that-.patch`](https://github.com/AdiRishi/offload-cms/blob/main/upstream/patches/0010-fix-storage-r2-keep-the-AWS-SDK-out-of-Workers-that-.patch)
